abstract: A rare case of multiple malignant tumors (poorly differentiated squamous cell carcinoma and high grade osteosarcoma) arising in an ovarian dermoid cyst of a 55 year old female is reported. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first well documented example of such an unusual combination of tumors arising in a dermoid cyst. The osteosarcoma and squamous cell carcinoma appear to arise in the background of benign teratomatous environment of a dermoid cyst rather than from "pure" mixed mesodermal tumors of the ovary. The tumors did not appear to have well demarcated boundaries with a junction or close intermingling of both cell types, features less favorable for collision tumor or carcinosarcoma. Despite extensive surgery with negative surgical margins and combination chemotherapy, the patient had recurrence of the tumor within four months and she died secondary to septicemia to chemotherapy and bilateral pulmonary emboli shortly after.
abstract_ja: 55歳女性の卵巣類皮嚢腫に、低分化扁平上皮癌と高異型度骨肉腫という二種類の悪性腫瘍が生じた症例を報告する。類皮嚢腫から複数の悪性腫瘍が生じた例は十分に文書化されておらず、我々の知る限り初めての報告である。両腫瘍は「純粋な」混合性中胚葉性腫瘍ではなく、類皮嚢腫の良性奇形腫性環境を背景に生じたと思われる。両細胞型の境界は明瞭ではなく、両者が密に混在する所見も認めなかったため、衝突腫瘍やカルチノサルコーマには当てはまりにくい。切除断端陰性の広範な手術と併用化学療法を行ったにもかかわらず、4か月以内に再発した。患者は敗血症と両側肺塞栓により死亡した。
